**Travel Advice**
Event attendees are responsible for all travel-related costs and should book their travel directly.


**Attire**
Business casual is recommended.


**Event Contact**
Should you have any questions or need immediate support either onsite or prior to attending the Executive Partner Meeting, please contact Melanie Stary at:Melanie.Stary@3DSystems.Com


**Space is Limited- Reserve Your Spot Today!**
Join us at the Executive Partner Event to gain the insights, tools, and connections needed to accelerate your business growth. We look forward to working with you to shape the future of additive manufacturing.
